title: AIOS AutoResearch v0.1 Semantic Evaluator Finding
description: One finding emitted by the blind A/B semantic evaluator (issue #394), governed by ChatGPT/[LLM]/Knowledge/AUTORESEARCH_SEMANTIC_EVALUATOR_CONTRACT.md. One finding = one material behavior or invariant. This schema deliberately has NO field for authority_status, merge_status, production_status, candidate identity (which of A/B is baseline vs. candidate), Researcher rationale/hypothesis, or a numeric aggregate score -- the Judge cannot carry or leak any of these through its output, by construction, not by convention.

finding.description: One material observation. Not a general summary of the whole comparison.

evidence.description: What in A and/or B actually supports this finding. Never a bare assertion.

affected_invariant_or_metric.description: An INV-nn id (autoresearch_v01_manifest.json), a named rubric dimension from the case_family (e.g. 'routing_correctness'), or 'JUDGE_DISAGREEMENT' for a disagreement finding (contract section 9).

verdict.description: Reuses AI_EVAL_REGISTRY.md's / AES 4.6's pass/revise/blocked vocabulary verbatim. No 'fail', no 'not_run': an unevaluable finding is 'blocked' with limitations stating why.

confidence.description: Textual, not a calibrated probability or governance metric (LLM_EVAL_STANDARD.md: 'Self-reported LLM confidence is not a governance metric or a calibrated probability').

limitations.description: Required even when empty-feeling; use an explicit short statement such as 'none material' rather than omitting the field.
